svg.text: Audiobook Manager --- Final Architecture (2026-11)
Local-first household audiobook server with an optional public demo --- one Node.js codebase, two listeners, two client surfaces.
CLIENT --- WEB
Web browser --- PWA
React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind
Light/dark themes -- IndexedDB read replica -- service worker
Served by the dev server locally; by Caddy / Render in deployment
CLIENT --- ANDROID
Android app --- Capacitor WebView
Same web bundle -- @capgo/capacitor-media-session foreground service
Biometric Vault holds the device credential -- offline downloads
Sideloaded APK -- HTTP LAN direct to the server (documented limitation)
DEPLOYMENT --- HOUSEHOLD (RECOMMENDED)
Home server -- Caddy -- books.home.arpa
Caddy :443 (`tls internal`, local root CA) --- app :3000
Android --- http://<lan-ip>:3000 -- admin panel on loopback :3100
Docker Compose (base + prod override) -- read-only media mount
Not yet deployed with Windows CA trust -- WebAuthn RP is books.home.arpa in prod config, localhost in dev
DEPLOYMENT --- PUBLIC DEMO (RENDER)
audiobook-manager.onrender.com
`ACCOUNT_EXPERIENCE=demo` -- open email/password + OAuth sign-up
Supabase Postgres (EU) + private Storage bucket -- persistent /data disk
Blueprint in `render.yaml` -- `/api/health` health check -- weekly age-encrypted dumps
Public beta -- accepted risks R1---R4 -- smoke-tested after each deploy
NODE.JS SERVER --- FASTIFY + PRISMA (DOCKER)
FAMILY LISTENER -- :3000
The app API
~13 route modules -- Fastify schema on every route -- no raw request.body
Auth sessions per profile -- household password break-glass -- passkeys / biometrics
Media-token streaming (5-min TTL) -- bounded ranges, 416 on bad ranges
Path confinement via `safePath` -- CORS allowlist -- errors are codes, never details
`ADMIN_PROXY=true` (demo only) forwards /admin + /api/admin/* --- 127.0.0.1:3100; household: 404
ADMIN LISTENER -- :3100
Operator panel --- a second door
Separate `ADMIN_PANEL_PASSWORD` -- SameSite=Strict cookie
Read-only status dashboard -- library controls -- purge/scan
DB explorer: allowlisted tables + query policy -- values redacted
API docs generated from live Fastify route schemas
Loopback by default; not on the household LAN unless deliberate
SCANNER --- ENRICHMENT PIPELINE
Walk configured LibraryRoots --- music-metadata + FFmpeg (tags -- chapters -- durations -- covers) --- group into books
Enrichment chain (per item): LibriVox --- Open Library --- Google Books -- best-effort, user confirms, overrides win (ADR 028)
Background runs enqueued on scan -- resumable (`EnrichmentRun`) -- never gates browsing/playback -- never writes to media files
DATA --- DATABASE
PostgreSQL in every production deploy
Household (books.home.arpa) and demo (Render) both run managed Postgres
SQLite is local dev/test only - never production (ADR 019)
31 models · RLS on every table (ADR 026) · both histories shipped
Database is the only irreplaceable state · weekly encrypted dumps
DATA --- FILESYSTEM
Read-only media
Configured LibraryRoots, read-only
Cover cache (`COVER_DIR`)
Paths never leave the server in responses
DATA --- STORAGE (DEMO)
Supabase Storage
Private `audiobooks` bucket
Service-role key server-only
Rebuilt into `/data` cache on the Render host
EXTERNAL SERVICES --- ALL OPTIONAL
Metadata providers: LibriVox -- Open Library -- Google Books (keyed) -- Audnexus (chapters by ASIN) | AI: LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible, local only
Enrichment sends book identifiers only, never personal data -- AI never gates core behaviour --- the app is fully usable with every provider down
Audiobook Manager - high-level view - see README_technical.md for detail, decisions/ for the 37 ADRs, specs/ for behaviour and acceptance criteria
